changes: Recorded the exact 16-role Proof-or-Stop prompt baseline, agent_prompt output hashes, reviewer-audited overlap matrix, and schema-v7 prompt-policy approval manifest. Added mechanical drift, legacy-vocabulary, direct-story-reference, and manifest self-authorization regression probes without editing prompt bodies.
usage: Run `node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs` for the complete check. Focused diagnostics are available through `--probe-prompt-policy-manifest`, `--probe-baseline-drift`, `--probe-role-matrix-snapshot-drift`, `--probe-legacy-vocabulary-policy`, and `--probe-direct-story-classifier`.
expectedOutcome: All 16 current role IDs and complete prompt bodies are hash-locked; agent_prompt and generated baseline artifacts match; a changed role/body cannot refresh the baseline until its independent code-reviewed manifest hash is updated; diagnostics expose current legacy and direct-story references.
actualTranscript: The full verifier passed all 16 manifest-bound roles, registry and agent_prompt hashes, matrix parity, and diagnostics. Manifest probes passed 8 structural mutations, 4 audit mutations, 2 synthetic collector failures, 12 direct and 8 legacy body mutations, plus refresh self-authorization rejection. TEST validate passed 45 configured commands. DONE-required build and full npm test both passed.
outcomeDiff: Expected and observed behavior match. No canonical prompt body was modified in M0; only the baseline artifacts, execution-plan wording, verifier, and ProofStory evidence changed.
limitations: This closes M0 baseline inventory only. Canonical proof-or-stop-* role migration, prompt consolidation, routing changes, and lifecycle closeout fixes remain in later milestones. Occurrence scanners are diagnostic; authorization comes from the independent full-prompt hash manifest.
pitfalls: Do not use baseline write mode to approve a prompt change. Update the independent manifest only with an explicitly reviewed full-body template hash, then regenerate the baseline. Human-authored role-matrix semantics remain reviewer-audited and are not inferred by the verifier.
